blocks.content: Deepti Gaur Mukerjee, a 1993-batch Indian Administrative Service officer of the Madhya Pradesh cadre, was appointed Secretary of the Department of Higher Education under the Ministry of Education on 10 August 2026. The Department of Personnel and Training issued the order during a bureaucratic reshuffle that also changed several senior posts in the Union Government.

items: The Department of Personnel and Training is the central personnel management department of the Government of India.
The Ministry of Education oversees school education and higher education in India.
The Indian Administrative Service is recruited through the Civil Services Examination conducted by the Union Public Service Commission.
The Ministry of Panchayati Raj deals with Panchayati Raj institutions under the constitutional framework of local self-government.
